description: Replace a quest with a new full definition (same schema as create_quest). The link and QR code stay the same. Pass if_updated_at (updatedAt from get_quest) so a co-editor's newer changes are not overwritten: if someone saved in between, the call fails with edit_conflict — re-read and merge.

edit_token.description: Only for quests not created with this owner key (the part after # in an editUrl)

if_updated_at.description: updatedAt from get_quest; refuses to overwrite newer changes

gift.description: text: text (e.g. a promo code). link: url. file: fileKey (from an upload with kind=gift) + fileName.

more.description: file gifts: more files in the same gift (Quest+)

lang.description: UI language of the recipient page

look.description: Only with theme "custom": its colours and an optional background photo

notify.description: Email the account owner (their verified sign-in email) when the gift is first opened

paper.description: Pattern of the wrapping paper on the gift box (default dots); its colour follows the theme

remind.description: Only if the user asks: one email to the account owner shortly before the quest is a year old, when the occasion comes round again

steps.description: Up to 10 free; more need Quest+

items.description: One quest step. Fields per type — message: prompt. question: prompt, answers[], optional image (a photo the question is about; Quest+). choice: prompt, options[2..6], correct (0-based index). code: prompt, code (a secret the recipient finds offline, e.g. written on a card). puzzle: image (key from an upload with kind=image), size 3|4, optional prompt. media (Quest+): media (key from an upload with kind=media), mediaType audio|video, optional prompt. date: prompt, date (YYYY-MM-DD; the recipient picks it in a calendar). number: prompt, number, optional tolerance (any answer within ± tolerance counts). qr: prompt (where to look), code (letters and digits) — a treasure hunt: the creator prints a card with a QR code that opens playUrl?k=<code> and hides it; the recipient scans it with the phone camera or types the code printed under it. The builder (editUrl) prints these cards; you can also make the QR yourself from playUrl + "?k=" + the URL-encoded code. candles: optional prompt, count 1..${MAX_CANDLES} (more than ${FREE_CANDLES} is Quest+, e.g. the age), optional image (a photo on the cake, Quest+) — the recipient blows into the microphone (or taps) to put out birthday candles. message: optional scratch: true hides the text under a layer the recipient rubs off; optional image (a photo in the letter, under the layer when scratch is on; Quest+). qr: optional note, a line printed on the card (e.g. where the next card is), printed with Quest+ only. place: prompt (where to go), lat, lng, optional radius in metres — hot or cold: the recipient walks there with the phone (GPS) and the screen warms up as they get closer; the coordinates never reach their browser. spot: prompt, image (a photo or a map screenshot), x and y (0..1 shares of the photo's width and height, from its top-left corner), optional r — the recipient taps the right spot on the photo. Any step: opensAt (an advent calendar: its first doors are free, more are Quest+).

code.description: code: the secret code; qr: the code on the printed card (up to 40 characters)

correct.description: choice: index of the right option

count.description: candles: how many candles (default 5; more than 10 is Quest+)

direction.description: place: show the way, not only warmer/colder — rough (one of eight directions, keeps it a game) or arrow (an arrow to within 10°; easiest, good for kids). Omit for hot/cold only

hint.description: Deprecated: a single hint (same as hints: [hint])

hints.description: Up to 3 hints, shown one by one: after the 1st, 3rd and 5th wrong answer. Encouragement, not a secret — the recipient's browser receives them with the step.

image.description: puzzle, spot (required); question, message, candles (optional, Quest+): image key from an upload with kind=image

media.description: media: key from an upload with kind=media (voice or video greeting)

note.description: qr: a line printed on the card (Quest+)

opensAt.description: Unix ms; this step opens only then (advent calendar: the first 3 doors are free, more need Quest+). Its content stays hidden until then.

r.description: spot: how big the target is, as a share of the photo (default 0.1)

radius.description: place: how close counts, in metres (default 50)

scratch.description: message: hide the text under a scratch layer

skippable.description: place: show a "Skip" button so the recipient can pass the step without walking there (a demo, or someone far away)

tolerance.description: number: answers within ± this count as right (default 0)

x.description: spot: horizontal position of the right spot, share of the photo width from the left

y.description: spot: vertical position, share of the photo height from the top

theme.description: gold, galaxy, sakura, ocean, christmas, wedding, pirate and custom are Quest+ themes: the recipient sees "classic" until the quest has Quest+

to.description: The recipient's first name (optional): shown as "For …" on the first screen and in the link's preview in messengers

unlockAt.description: Unix ms; the gift cannot be opened before this moment

unwrap.description: How the recipient opens the gift at the end: hands (default) — pull the ribbon to untie the bow, then tap to tear the paper off; tap — one tap on the box

name: update_quest
title: Update a quest
